name: v0.8.0
body:
## Summary

MDK 0.8.0 is a protocol, security, and mobile-bindings release.

This release adds the first MIP-05 notification building blocks, moves MIP-00 key packages to addressable events, improves mixed-version group compatibility, expands UniFFI coverage, and tightens several security-sensitive validation paths around admins, commits, storage, encryption bounds, and replay handling.

## Changes

### Protocol and group behavior

- Added MIP-05 primitives and leaf-index helpers. ([#235](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/235) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Added a MIP-05 notification request builder. ([#238](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/238) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Updated MIP-05 push tokens to opaque variable-length data with larger token support. ([#254](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/254) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Migrated MIP-00 KeyPackage events to addressable kind:30443 events. ([#233](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/233) by [@dannym-arx](https://github.com/dannym-arx))
- Added SelfRemove proposal support for voluntary group departure in MIP-03. ([#236](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/236) by [@jgmontoya](https://github.com/jgmontoya))
- Converged the self-update wire format. ([#264](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/264) by [@jgmontoya](https://github.com/jgmontoya))
- Added a group context extensions upgrade path. ([#266](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/266) by [@jgmontoya](https://github.com/jgmontoya))
- Computed group required capabilities from invitee capabilities to support mixed-version invites. ([#261](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/261) by [@jgmontoya](https://github.com/jgmontoya))
- Added a `group_required_proposals` accessor. ([#265](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/265) by [@jgmontoya](https://github.com/jgmontoya))
- Allowed custom tags on the outer kind:445 wrapper. ([#248](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/248) by [@mehmetefeumit](https://github.com/mehmetefeumit))

### Security and correctness

- Pruned invalid admins before group validation and updates. ([#223](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/223) by [@jgmontoya](https://github.com/jgmontoya))
- Stripped admin status atomically when removing members. ([#225](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/225) by [@mubarakcoded](https://github.com/mubarakcoded))
- Added migration compatibility fallbacks for 0.6.x to 0.7.x upgrades. ([#222](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/222) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Tightened encrypted content minimum length checks from 12 bytes to 28 bytes. ([#230](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/230) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Added ciphertext deduplication to reject re-wrapped event replay during commit ordering. ([#246](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/246) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Fixed memory storage message payload bounds. ([#257](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/257) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Prevented memory storage eviction of security-critical state. ([#259](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/259) by [@mubarakcoded](https://github.com/mubarakcoded))
- Fixed receiver-side admin depletion validation. ([#256](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/256) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Parsed invitee key packages before persisting creator signer data. ([#262](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/262) by [@jgmontoya](https://github.com/jgmontoya))
- Added a typed error variant for add-members proposal rejection. ([#263](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/263) by [@jgmontoya](https://github.com/jgmontoya))
- Encoded SQLite keys before keyring storage. ([#270](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/270) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))

### APIs, bindings, and media

- Added missing UniFFI bindings for 10 existing methods. ([#249](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/249) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Auto-initialized the platform keyring store in `new_mdk()`. ([#252](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/252) by [@sjmcnamara](https://github.com/sjmcnamara))
- Added public `delete_messages_for_group` and `delete_group` methods for local cleanup. ([#250](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/250) by [@jgmontoya](https://github.com/jgmontoya))
- Added thumbhash support alongside blurhash compatibility. ([#244](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/244) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Gated `new_unencrypted()` behind the `test-utils` feature flag. ([#245](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/245) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Exposed the `test_util` module behind a `test-utils` Cargo feature. ([#269](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/269) by [@jgmontoya](https://github.com/jgmontoya))
- Reduced release binary size for Android and iOS bindings. ([#221](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/221) by [@dannym-arx](https://github.com/dannym-arx))

### Tooling, CI, docs, and maintenance

- Refreshed the README for Marmot. ([#211](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/211) by [@dannym-arx](https://github.com/dannym-arx))
- Added `cargo audit` to CI and precommit checks. ([#229](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/229) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Updated `hpke-rs` to 0.6.1 to address RUSTSEC-2026-0073 and RUSTSEC-2026-0074. ([#234](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/234) by [@dannym-arx](https://github.com/dannym-arx))
- Fixed CI binding builds on Linux and Swift package publishing. ([#267](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/267) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Removed redundant builds and restored the release profile in CI. ([#232](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/232) by [@dannym-arx](https://github.com/dannym-arx))
- Removed the `trees` subdirectory and updated `.gitignore`. ([#237](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/237) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))
- Refactored internal code to reduce duplication. ([#239](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/239) by [@dannym-arx](https://github.com/dannym-arx))
- Prepared the 0.8.0 release. ([#271](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/271) by [@erskingardner](https://github.com/erskingardner))

## New contributors

Thanks to the contributors who landed their first MDK PR in this release:

- [@mehmetefeumit](https://github.com/mehmetefeumit) in [#248](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/248)
- [@sjmcnamara](https://github.com/sjmcnamara) in [#252](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/pull/252)

## Full changelog

[Compare v0.7.1...v0.8.0](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/mdk/compare/v0.7.1...v0.8.0)
